native.host: One reusable 688 × 380 logical-pixel borderless Windows Forms tool window for calendar, settings, three preference pages and OAuth editing; no app-window taskbar button.
native.interaction: Pinned date toggles the flyout and acknowledges pending reminders. Gear opens inline settings and local preferences. Meet action/Alt+Enter joins; card/Enter opens its event. Background startup remains hidden.
native.identity: Incumbent red/white weekday/day icon and native executable identity; no explicit AppUserModelID.
native.elevation: Windows native shadow and requested DWM rounded corners; event cards have borders and no shadows.
native.dpi: 688 × 380 logical pixels; actual window DPI scales bounds, fonts and painting; constrained work areas scroll.
native.reminders: Non-activating, click-through layered overlay kept above Explorer; Google popup rules; current-user DPAPI pending and snoozed-batch state; independent new notifications; three local sounds, volume/mute, quiet hours and pulse levels; no ICO rewrite.
native.taskbarTip: Optional 650ms pointer dwell over the pin; 360 × 64 logical-pixel non-activating click-through Form above the taskbar. Hide off-pin or when calendar opens; private mode masks title.
native.preferences: Three inline tabs: calendars/source-color overrides; sound/volume/quiet hours; privacy/pulse/taskbar tip. DPAPI local storage, Save applies and Back discards the draft. Google remains read-only.
native.agenda: 0.6.3: only ongoing/future events with end > local clock appear in day/week lists, counts and dots. Remove completed entries at the next-end deadline via the per-second background tick, without API wait. Healthy confirmed empty today shows exactly На сегодня митов больше нет, приятного вечера; error/loading/hidden-calendar states retain precedence. Calendar-symbol button 32×32 at (560,16), accessible Google Calendar browser action; next label (24,328), 296×18, 12px below grid and 8px extra left inset. Meet and wheel behavior retained.
native.settingsVersion: Settings-only subtitle: WinCalendar · followed by typeof(CalendarPanel).Assembly.GetName().Version.ToString(3), showing major.minor.build (current 0.6.4). Calendar weekday subtitle, geometry and styling are unchanged.

verification.verified: Installed native baseline probe passes: one hidden startup process, real today row, shared calendar/settings/preferences/client-editor HWND, no app-window/indicator, pinned preview without activation or ICO rewrite, date command stops preview, final hidden state. Current 0.6.3 installed agenda probe exits successfully: four week rows, scroll 0→1→0, same window, return to day with the exact evening message visible, final flyout hidden. Full self-test regenerated baseline capture files; latest fresh review covers twelve remaining-meetings/evening captures for this exact scope.
limits: Requested DPI renders do not verify real mixed-monitor transitions.
Pinned-icon rollover after real midnight remains unverified.
Actual pinned-date hover has no user confirmation in this run.
Real ten-minute snooze waiting was not performed; the five-minute interval passed with user confirmation.
verification.realScheduledReminder: Historical baseline on 2026-11-12: configured Google reminder at 16:03 fired at 16:03:01 local; pending state survived restart and event end. User confirmed visible stronger pulse and disappearance after clicking; native watcher confirmed pulse false and calendar visible at 16:10:39, still hidden 33 seconds later. This does not validate new snooze or tooltip behavior.
verification.connectedRead: Earlier read-only aggregate: six readable calendars, two events in a two-day range, two Meet links and two timed events with popup reminders; no new consent. The subsequent five-minute snooze used one separately authorized test event without guests, Meet or invitations.
verification.taskbarTip: Real Form tested with controlled anchor, pointer and clock: no activation, stable placement and hide off pin. No user confirmation of actual pinned-date hover in this run.
verification.snooze: Real five-minute check on 2026-11-12: first pulse 18:59:00.484; acknowledgement/snooze saved 19:04:14.133 deadline at 18:59:14.133; repeat 19:04:14.541 (+408ms); user confirmed and clicked clear at 19:04:17.631. Installed app was not updated during timer. Google post-read retained original 19:00 start and popup one minute. Ten-minute deadlines, restart and independent new notifications are covered by controlled clocks; no real ten-minute wait.
verification.agendaRefinement: 0.6.3: all twelve remaining-meetings and remaining-evening light/dark 96/120/144 captures opened by implementer and fresh reviewer; remaining-agenda finish review ship with no material fixes. Six new tests cover remaining counts, exact-end removal without network wait, exact evening wording, cleared date dot, week filtering and error precedence. Baseline feature/agenda files were regenerated by this self-test, but the latest fresh scope review is the twelve remaining captures. Prior full feature review was 0.6 baseline.

narrative.overview:
The date icon remains the product's primary surface: red weekday strip, white paper, large day number, and Segoe UI. Clicking it toggles a compact two-pane calendar: month navigation on the left, clearly separated meeting cards on the right. The approved wider layout preserves the icon's identity and restrained theme-aware surfaces while making meetings easier to scan.

Background startup keeps the native host minimized and opens neither popup nor browser. Once pinned, the launcher remains visible while the host removes its own taskbar button. The calendar must preserve this absence of a running-app indicator.
keyCharacteristics: Calendar left, meetings right, within the retained 688 × 380 logical-pixel shell.
Event time, two-line title, local source color, conflict label and a separate Meet action.
Calendar, settings, all three preference tabs and OAuth editing reuse one native tool window.
Current/next meeting, seven-day agenda and consistent privacy masks across visible and accessible surfaces.
Local snooze, three sounds, volume/mute, quiet hours and pulse strength preserve read-only Google behavior.
dos: Do preserve the established icon geometry, palette, glyphs and native executable identity.
Do retain theme contrast, visible keyboard focus and readable DPI-scaled labels.
Do apply calendar filters and privacy consistently to cards, date dots, tooltips, accessible text and background attention.
Do keep calendar, settings, preferences and OAuth editing inside one reusable flyout.
Do keep background startup hidden, reminder overlays click-through, and taskbar tips non-activating.
Do retain visual attention during quiet hours and defer only the selected local reminder batch.
Do distinguish loading, empty, offline snapshots and renewed sign-in.
donts: **Don't** add a separate taskbar button or running-app indicator for the popup.
**Don't** animate by rewriting the pinned date icon or rebuild separate modal setup windows.
**Don't** treat rendered DPI samples as proof of real mixed-monitor behavior or real-midnight rollover.
**Don't** present synthetic events or authorization tests as a verified real-account connection.
